scripts.sync-registry: node --input-type=module -e "import { cpSync, mkdirSync } from 'node:fs'; mkdirSync('public', { recursive: true }); cpSync('../../packages/react/registry/r', 'public/r', { recursive: true }); cpSync('../../packages/react/registry/registry.json', 'public/r/index.json');"
scripts.dev: pnpm run sync-registry && pnpm --filter @easyui/react run build && vite
scripts.build: pnpm --filter @easyui/react run build && pnpm run sync-registry && tsc --noEmit && vite build
